You can refer friends who are new customers, and if they make a purchase, you'll receive a $20 reward. Your friend will also get a $20 gift toward their first purchase. You can refer as many friends as you'd like, but you'll receive one $20 reward per successful referral.If you want more details or are interested in other types of loyalty programs, let me know!
